title: Sparkle: Realizing Lively Instruction-Guided Video Background Replacement via Decoupled Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2605.06535v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, open-source efforts like Senorita-2M have propelled video editing toward natural language instruction. However, current publicly available datasets predominantly focus on local editing or style transfer, which largely preserve the original scene structure and are easier to scale. In contrast, Background Replacement, a task central to creative applications such as film production and advertising, requires synthesizing entirely new, temporally consistent scenes while maintaining accurate foreground-background interactions, making large-scale data generation significantly more challenging. Consequently, this complex task remains largely underexplored due to a scarcity of high-quality training data. This gap is evident in poorly performing state-of-the-art models, e.g., Kiwi-Edit, because the primary open-source dataset that contains this task, i.e., OpenVE-3M, frequently produces static, unnatural backgrounds. translated_title: Sparkle：通过解耦引导实现生动的指令引导视频背景替换
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.06535v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 摘要：近年来，像 Senorita-2M 这样的开源工作推动了视频编辑向自然语言指令方向发展。然而，当前公开可用的数据集主要聚焦于局部编辑或风格迁移，这些任务在很大程度上保留了原始场景结构，更容易进行规模化扩展。相比之下，背景替换作为影视制作和广告等创意应用中的核心任务，需要在保持准确的前景-背景交互的同时，合成全新的、时间上一致的场景，这使得大规模数据生成面临显著更大的挑战。因此，由于高质量训练数据的匮乏，这一复杂任务在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。这一差距在表现不佳的最先进模型（如 Kiwi-Edit）中显而易见，因为包含该任务的主要开源数据集 OpenVE-3M 经常生成静态且不自然的背景。
tldr: 本文提出 Sparkle，通过解耦引导机制实现生动的指令驱动视频背景替换，解决了现有模型因高质量训练数据匮乏而生成静态、不自然背景的问题。
en_tdlr: Sparkle realizes lively instruction-guided video background replacement through decoupled guidance, addressing the problem of static, unnatural backgrounds caused by the scarcity of high-quality training data.
